title: Nourishing Silky Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A herbal and silky Algerian dish featuring vegan white wine vinegar, perfect for a sick day, and a low-carb friendly option, all wrapped up in a ti-leaf vessel.
instructions: Wrap the ti leaves around a large bowl to create a vessel for the tagine.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the vegan white wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Shock the mixture in an ice bath to stop the cooking process and give it a silky texture.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the tagine in the ti-leaf vessel and enjoy.
Discard the ti leaves after serving.
